name: standing straight leg hamstring contract relax on exercise ball
description: A hamstring stretch with the heel on a stability ball, using a contract and relax method. It helps you ease deeper into the stretch.
instructions: Stand and rest one heel on a stability ball in front of you with your knee straight.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Gently press your heel into the ball for about 5 seconds, then relax.
Lean a little deeper into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
